]

# dev dependencies

    "mkdocs==1.6.1",

    "codespell==2.4.1",
    "pytest-mypy-plugins==3.2.0",
]

    "coverage[toml]==7.7.0",
    "pytest==8.3.5",

    "jsondiff==2.2.1",
